signature.name: VTask.sylvester
signature.type: {R : Type u_1} -> [Semiring R] -> (f g : Polynomial R) -> (m n : ℕ) -> Matrix (Fin (m + n)) (Fin (m + n)) R

conventions.statement: When m = 0 the g-coefficient block of columns is empty and the matrix reduces to an n × n matrix whose columns are all f-coefficient strips.
conventions.note: Degenerate case; still well-typed as a (0+n) × (0+n) matrix.

conventions.statement: When n = 0 the f-coefficient block of columns is empty and the matrix reduces to an m × m matrix whose columns are all g-coefficient strips.
conventions.note: Degenerate case; still well-typed as a (m+0) × (m+0) matrix.

conventions.statement: When both m = 0 and n = 0 the result is the unique 0 × 0 empty matrix.

conventions.point: natDegree f < n or natDegree g < m
conventions.statement: If the actual degree of f is less than n (or g less than m), extra coefficient entries beyond the degree are defined to be 0 by the convention of Polynomial.coeff, so the matrix is padded with zeros without any error.
conventions.note: m and n are free parameters; the matrix is total for all values.

conventions.statement: Matrix entries whose row index does not fall in the shifted coefficient interval are defined to be the zero element of R.
conventions.note: This makes the matrix sparse / banded.

facts.statement: ∀ (R S : Type*) [CommSemiring R] [CommSemiring S] (φ : R →+* S) (f g : Polynomial R) (m n : ℕ), VTask.sylvester (Polynomial.map φ f) (Polynomial.map φ g) m n = φ.mapMatrix (VTask.sylvester f g m n)

provenance.note: authored by eu.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6; certified by the v1.2 kernel validation ladder

facts.statement: ¬ ∀ (f g : Polynomial ℤ) (m n : ℕ), VTask.sylvester f g m n = VTask.sylvester g f m n
